messages.subject: why does this widget reinitialize its value ??
parts:
Dear shiny users !!!

I have a basic question on the reactivity of my script (see below).

The aim of my app is to attribute a flag 1 of a selectInput if users click on a reactiveButton. Here is my script :

library("shiny")
runApp(list(
  ui = bootstrapPage(
    uiOutput("choix"),
    uiOutput("valid")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
#    
    flag = reactiveValues(temp = list(
      sample1 <- list(
        type = NA,
        temoin = c(0,0,0,0,0),
        names = c("ech1", "ech2"),
        dataInterm = NA,
        dataFinal = NA
      ),
     
      sample2 <- list(
        type = NA,
        temoin = c(0,0,0,0,0),
        dataFinal = NA,
        dataInterm = NA,
        names = c("ech3", "ech4")
      )
     
    ))
   
    observe({
      names(flag$temp) = c("sample1","sample2")
    })
   
    output$choix <- renderUI({
     
      selectInput("exchoix","",choices = names(flag$temp))
     
    })
   
    output$valid <- renderUI({
     
      actionButton("valid","valider")
     
    })
   
    observe({
      if(is.null(input$valid)){}
      else{
          isolate({
            if(input$valid > 0){
              flag$temp[[grep(isolate(input$exchoix),names(flag$temp))]]$temoin[1] = 1
              print(flag$temp[[grep(isolate(input$exchoix),names(flag$temp))]]$temoin)
            }
          })      
         }
     
     
      })
   

  }
 
))

For the first selectInput ("Sample1") no problem, but when user clicks on the actionButton for Sample2, the selectInput reinitialize its choice with selecting the Sample1 again (without willing of user).

I tried many ways to isolate this function but I did not manage that the selectInput stays in this "Sample2" choice when the actionButton of the Sample2 is pushed

Does someone have a solution ?

Thank you very much for your help !

Cha

parts:
Hi,

I haven't had much success with your example so far but in case it helps I have noticed that the widget's update only occurs the first time you validate sample2. If you repeat the operation a second time the selectInput widget is not updated (or maybe IT IS but in in the right way). This might be relevant to why this happens.

Best regards,
Bastien
